summary: Frontend UI Testing for Mango Health Labs Portal - All requested UI color changes verified successfully. Hero banner displays Jungle Green (bg-green-500), 'Build' button has white background with green text, 'Add to Cart' buttons have dark green (bg-green-700) background. All functionality working correctly.
test_credentials: Guest mode - clicked 'Guest' button to bypass login
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI color changes for Mango Health Labs portal verified: 1) Hero banner uses bg-green-500 (Jungle Green), 2) 'Build Your Own Package' button has white background with green text, 3) 'Add to Cart' buttons use bg-green-700 (dark green). All checkup and test cards display correctly with green theme.

features_tested.feature: Mango Health Labs portal loads at /mango route
features_tested.details: Portal loads correctly with hero banner, 'Build Your Own Package' section, search bar, and test listings

features_tested.feature: Hero banner displays in Jungle Green (bg-green-500)
features_tested.details: Hero banner with 'Blood Test At Home' and Mango logo displays solid green background (bg-green-500). The banner shows Reports in 6 Hours, Home Collection, and NABL Certified badges.

features_tested.feature: 'Build Your Own Package' banner with white 'Build' button
features_tested.details: Banner at top shows 'Build Your Own Package' with 'Build' button having white background and green text. data-testid='package-builder-btn' found.

features_tested.feature: 'Add to Cart' buttons in Most Booked Checkups are dark green
features_tested.details: Found 23 'Add to Cart' buttons. All buttons have bg-green-700 class (dark green background with white text). Visible in checkup cards for Diabetes Screening, Thyroid Profile, Lipid Profile, Liver Function Test, Kidney Function Test.

features_tested.feature: 'Add to Cart' buttons in Most Booked Tests are dark green
features_tested.details: Test cards (CBC, Vitamin D, Vitamin B12, HbA1c, TSH, FBS) all have dark green 'Add to Cart' buttons matching the checkup section styling.
Clicking 'Add to Cart' on Diabetes Screening successfully added 3 tests to cart. Toast notification displayed: 'Diabetes Screening selected! 3 tests added.'
Search input with data-testid='hero-search' found and functional. Typing search terms shows filtered test results.

features_tested.feature: Navigation to test selection via View All
features_tested.details: Clicking 'View All' navigates to test selection page with Pathology/Imaging tabs, 'Holistic Women Care' section with test categories (Pregnancy Tests, Fertility Profile, PCOS Panel, Thyroid Profile, etc.)
